notes_en: New: global shortcuts (F11 fullscreen / Esc back / Ctrl+S save & quit)

New: menu number keys, plus story and event shortcuts
New: one-time battle tips on first entry
New: adjustable UI font size (Small / Normal / Large / Extra large)
